description: This file contains multiple classes implementing grains and timer functionality for Orleans, including TimerGrain, TimerCallGrain, and their Poco variants, with associated timer management and testing methods.

classes.name: TimerGrain
classes.description: Implements a grain with timer management, including starting, stopping, and ticking timers, and deactivation logic.

classes.name: TimerCallGrain
classes.description: A grain that manages timers with advanced control including restarting, stopping, and self-disposing timers, with detailed logging and context checks.

classes.name: NonReentrantTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A non-reentrant timer grain that ensures timer callbacks do not re-enter, with context validation and exception handling.

classes.name: TimerRequestGrain
classes.description: A grain for testing timer registration overloads and synchronization via task completion sources.

classes.name: PocoTimerGrain
classes.description: A Plain Old CLR Object (POCO) implementation of a timer grain with similar functionality to TimerGrain.

classes.name: PocoTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A POCO variant of TimerCallGrain managing timers with extended control, included DI for grain factory, with logging and context validation.

classes.name: PocoNonReentrantTimerCallGrain
classes.description: A POCO implementation similar to NonReentrantTimerCallGrain, with proper timer management, context validation, and exception handling.

classes.name: PocoTimerRequestGrain
classes.description: POCO version of TimerRequestGrain for testing timer overloads via task completion sources.

methods.name: OnActivateAsync
methods.description: Overrides activation logic to initialize timer management and context.

methods.name: StopDefaultTimer
methods.description: Stops the default timer and disposes of it.

methods.name: Tick
methods.description: Callback method invoked on timer tick, updates counters, and logs information.

methods.name: StartTimer
methods.description: Starts a timer with specified name.

methods.name: LongWait
methods.description: Causes the grain to wait for a specified duration.

methods.name: ThrowIfDeactivating
methods.description: Throws an exception if the grain is deactivating.

methods.name: ProcessTimerTick
methods.description: Handles timer tick processing, including calling other grains and validating runtime context.

methods.name: CheckRuntimeContext
methods.description: Validates current runtime context and task scheduler against stored context.

methods.name: LogStatus
methods.description: Logs detailed status info including runtime context and thread.

methods.name: ExternalTick
methods.description: External trigger to process timer tick with a given name.

methods.name: PollCompletedTimers
methods.description: Checks how many timers have completed.

methods.name: TestCompletedTimerResults
methods.description: Verifies the results of timer callbacks for correctness and consistency.
